# RISC_V_Open_ISA

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-24

## Definition
RISC-V is an open instruction set architecture that Tenstorrent uses as the foundation for its AI-capable CPU cores. Its openness allows TCC and iNEST researchers to customize instruction-level and topological interfaces without proprietary restrictions.
